strategy.goal: Complement the curated Boribon portfolio with distinctive Kidstory products that strengthen TechTots' STEM identity and content/ad potential.
strategy.pricingNote: Kidstory base_price is treated here only as a B2C/retail reference. The planned TechTots extra 25% buffer is intentionally ignored.
strategy.activationGuard: Do not activate a SKU until its private B2B gross cost is available and unit economics are validated.
selectionPrinciples: Genuine STEM learning through building, experimenting, observing or coding
Immediate visual hook suitable for short-form content and ads
Complement Boribon instead of duplicating strong existing categories
Balanced price ladder from low-cost acquisition to premium hero products
Prefer ecosystems and repeat-purchase opportunities where available

products.name: Air Toobz Set de tuburi de aer interconectabile (joc STEM interactiv)
products.contentHook: Can you make this ball float?
products.rationale: Flagship visual demo; visible airflow, construction and experimentation.

products.name: Set educativ STEM - AQUA DRAGONS Habitat VULCAN cu lava - acvariu cu LED si Aqua Dragons rosii
products.contentHook: Hatch living Aqua Dragons and follow them day by day.
products.rationale: Creates a multi-week content series and a refill ecosystem.

products.name: Code A Maze - joc educativ de programare
products.contentHook: A child programs a robot without a screen.
products.rationale: Strong screen-free coding proposition and clear TechTots differentiation.

products.name: Kit experimente KidzLabs - Tren Maglev fosforescent de mare viteza
products.contentHook: Why does this train not touch the track?
products.rationale: Maglev is instantly demonstrable and connects play to real transport technology.

products.name: Microscop portabil MicroFlip 100-250x cu LED, UV, adaptor smartphone si 24 lamele pregatite
products.contentHook: Guess what this looks like at 250x.
products.rationale: Smartphone-compatible microscope plus prepared slides creates near-unlimited content.

products.name: Mega Brat Hidraulic KidzLabs
products.contentHook: Move a robot arm using only water pressure.
products.rationale: Visible real-world engineering mechanism and strong build/demo value.

products.name: Proiector Holograma KidzLabs
products.contentHook: Build a 3D hologram illusion at home.
products.rationale: Low-priced, high-curiosity visual effect suited to short video.

products.name: Microscop portabil MicroFlip 100-250x cu LED, UV si adaptor smartphone
products.contentHook: A laboratory that fits in your pocket.
products.rationale: Lower-price entry into the same strong MicroFlip science/content ecosystem.

products.name: Observator insecte BugView, cu lupa marire 5x
products.contentHook: Catch and inspect a bug without touching it.
products.rationale: Outdoor exploration adds breadth beyond indoor kits.

products.name: Kit constructie robot - T-Rex, Kidz Robotix
products.contentHook: Build a moving T-Rex robot.
products.rationale: Combines robotics with a highly attractive dinosaur theme.

products.name: Kit constructie robot - Motorised Robot Hand, Kidz Robotix
products.contentHook: Build a motorised robotic hand.
products.rationale: Mechanical movement is easy to demonstrate and understand in ads.

products.name: Kit stiintific detectiv - senzor de miscare paianjen KidzLabs
products.contentHook: A spider that detects movement.
products.rationale: Surprise and motion create a strong short-form hook while introducing sensors.

products.name: Kit experimente KidzLabs - Levitatie magnetica antigravitationala
products.contentHook: Make a pencil float and build a mini Maglev.
products.rationale: Multiple visible physics experiments from one kit.

products.name: Kit DIY Green Science - Robot Rover hibrid cu energie solara
products.contentHook: Build a rover powered by solar energy.
products.rationale: Adds sustainability and energy engineering with a moving end result.

products.name: Kit stiintific - Explorarea Spatiului, STEAM Kids
products.contentHook: Turn space exploration into hands-on experiments.
products.rationale: Adds astronomy and space breadth to the science assortment.

products.name: Joc electronic Logiblocs - set Spy Tech
products.contentHook: Build secret-message and spy gadgets.
products.rationale: Storytelling makes electronics easier to market than a generic circuit starter kit.

products.name: Masinuta antigravitationala Zero-gravity Fridge Rover, KidzLabs
products.contentHook: Why does this little car climb the fridge?
products.rationale: Very low entry price with an immediate visual hook.

products.name: Mini experiment - sparge o geoda (cristal)
products.contentHook: Crack open a geode-style science experience.
products.rationale: Low-risk first purchase and excellent unboxing/reveal content.

products.name: Set constructie Plus-Plus, tub 100 piese, Robot
products.contentHook: Build a robot from 100 tiny Plus-Plus pieces.
products.rationale: Affordable basket builder with clear STEM-adjacent construction value.

products.name: Set de Activitati Plus-Plus, 125 piese, Spatiu
products.contentHook: Build a mini space world from Plus-Plus.
products.rationale: Affordable add-on that reinforces the space theme.

products.name: Air Toobz - 20 de bile extra pentru seturile Air Toobz
products.contentHook: More balls, more experiments.
products.rationale: Repeat-purchase accessory for the Air Toobz flagship.

products.name: Accesoriu Air Toobz, schimbator de directie pentru trasee
products.contentHook: Change the airflow direction.
products.rationale: Adds experimentation depth and repeat purchase.

products.name: Kit de extindere traseu Air Toobz, tub flexibil 30 m
products.contentHook: Build a much longer flexible airflow route.
products.rationale: High-value extension for engaged Air Toobz customers.

products.name: Set educativ STEM - AQUA DRAGONS Lumea subacvatica - kit reumplere starter
products.contentHook: Restart the living-science experiment.
products.rationale: Creates a genuine replenishment and repeat-purchase loop.

products.name: Set experimente de crescut Cristale, terariu cu Dinozauri
products.contentHook: Grow crystals inside a dinosaur terrarium.
products.rationale: Very strong transformation content, but mixed external feedback means test a unit before paid ads.
